healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Intercom token by listing one administrator.

admins.list.title: List Admins
admins.list.description: List accessible Intercom administrators, optionally including avatar data.

contacts.list.title: List Contacts
contacts.list.description: List accessible Intercom contacts with bounded pagination.

companies.list.title: List Companies
companies.list.description: List accessible Intercom companys with bounded pagination.

conversations.list.title: List Conversations
conversations.list.description: List Intercom conversations with bounded cursor pagination (per_page, starting_after).

conversations.get.title: Get Conversation
conversations.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom conversation by id (includes conversation_parts).

conversations.reply.title: Reply to Conversation
conversations.reply.description: Reply to an Intercom conversation as an admin (comment or note) via POST /conversations/{id}/reply. A reply creates a conversation part, so no EffectPolicy is declared; the handler returns the raw Conversation.

id.description: Intercom conversation id, or the literal "last".

messageType.description: comment posts to the customer; note is internal.

conversations.close.title: Close Conversation
conversations.close.description: Close an Intercom conversation via POST /conversations/{id}/parts (message_type close). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via conversations.get.

conversations.assign.title: Assign Conversation
conversations.assign.description: Assign an Intercom conversation via POST /conversations/{id}/parts (message_type assignment). assigneeId may be admin or team id; "0" unassigns. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via conversations.get.

conversations.tag.title: Tag Conversation
conversations.tag.description: Add a tag via POST /conversations/{id}/tags (body id=tagId, admin_id). Upstream returns Tag; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes conversation via conversations.get.

contacts.get.title: Get Contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom contact by id via GET /contacts/{id}.

conversations.search.title: Search Conversations
conversations.search.description: Search Intercom conversations via POST /conversations/search. Pass Intercom Search query object; optional perPage/startingAfter map to pagination.

query.description: Intercom Search query (single filter {field,operator,value} or AND/OR tree).

contacts.create.title: Create Contact
contacts.create.description: Create an Intercom contact via POST /contacts. email is required. Optional role (user or lead), name, externalId, phone.

role.description: Contact role. Defaults to user on the provider side if omitted.

contacts.update.title: Update Contact
contacts.update.description: Update an Intercom contact via PUT /contacts/{id}. id is required. Only the fields you pass are changed.

contacts.delete.title: Delete Contact
contacts.delete.description: Permanently delete an Intercom contact via DELETE /contacts/{id}. This cannot be undone.

companies.create.title: Create Company
companies.create.description: Create an Intercom company via POST /companies. companyId is the caller-defined company id (maps to company_id) and is required. Optional name, website, industry, plan.

companies.get.title: Get Company
companies.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom company by id via GET /companies/{id}.

tickets.list.title: List Tickets
tickets.list.description: Search Intercom tickets via POST /tickets/search (Intercom has no unfiltered GET /tickets list). Pass an Intercom Search query object; optional perPage/startingAfter map to pagination.

query.description: Intercom Search query (single filter {field,operator,value} or AND/OR tree).

tickets.create.title: Create Ticket
tickets.create.description: Create an Intercom ticket via POST /tickets. ticketTypeId and contacts are required. Optional ticketAttributes is the Intercom ticket_attributes object (e.g. _default_title_, _default_description_).

contacts.description: Contacts to attach, each typically {id} or {email}.

tickets.reply.title: Reply to Ticket
tickets.reply.description: Reply to an Intercom ticket via POST /tickets/{id}/reply as an admin (comment or note).

messageType.description: comment posts to the customer; note is internal.

tags.create.title: Create Tag
tags.create.description: Create an Intercom tag via POST /tags. name is required. If a tag with that name exists, Intercom returns the existing tag.

contacts.tag.title: Tag Contact
contacts.tag.description: Attach a tag to an Intercom contact via POST /contacts/{id}/tags. Body id is the tag id.

admins.get.title: Get Admin
admins.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom administrator by id via GET /admins/{id}.

conversations.reopen.title: Reopen conversation
conversations.reopen.description: Reopen an Intercom conversation as an admin (POST /conversations/{id}/parts with message_type=open). Reconciles against conversations.get.

adminId.description: Admin performing the reopen (maps to admin_id).

conversations.create.title: Create conversation
conversations.create.description: Create a contact-initiated Intercom conversation (POST /conversations). Returns the provider message JSON, including conversation_id.

conversations.untag.title: Untag conversation
conversations.untag.description: Remove a tag from an Intercom conversation (DELETE /conversations/{id}/tags/{tagId} with admin_id body). Reconciles against conversations.get.

adminId.description: Admin removing the tag (maps to admin_id).

contacts.search.title: Search contacts
contacts.search.description: Search Intercom contacts (POST /contacts/search) with a query object and cursor pagination.

query.description: Intercom Search query (single filter {field,operator,value} or AND/OR tree).

contacts.archive.title: Archive contact
contacts.archive.description: Archive an Intercom contact (POST /contacts/{id}/archive). No EffectPolicy: the contact object returned by contacts.get has no archived field.

contacts.unarchive.title: Unarchive contact
contacts.unarchive.description: Unarchive an Intercom contact (POST /contacts/{id}/unarchive). No EffectPolicy: the contact object returned by contacts.get has no archived field.

contacts.untag.title: Untag contact
contacts.untag.description: Remove a tag from an Intercom contact (DELETE /contacts/{id}/tags/{tagId}). Reconciles against contacts.get.

contacts.attach_company.title: Attach company to contact
contacts.attach_company.description: Attach an Intercom company to a contact (POST /contacts/{id}/companies).

companyId.description: Intercom company id (maps to body id).

contacts.detach_company.title: Detach company from contact
contacts.detach_company.description: Detach an Intercom company from a contact (DELETE /contacts/{id}/companies/{companyId}).

companies.update.title: Update company
companies.update.description: Update an Intercom company (PUT /companies/{id}). Reconciles against companies.get.

id.description: Intercom company id (the Intercom-assigned id, not company_id).

monthlySpend.description: Monthly spend in whole units (maps to monthly_spend).

tickets.get.title: Get ticket
tickets.get.description: Get an Intercom ticket by id (GET /tickets/{id}).

tickets.update.title: Update ticket
tickets.update.description: Update an Intercom ticket (PUT /tickets/{id}): attributes, state, open/snoozed, assignment. Reconciles against tickets.get.

snoozedUntil.description: Unix timestamp to snooze until (maps to snoozed_until).

assignee_id.description: Admin or team id to assign; "0" unassigns.

assignment.description: Provider assignment object, passed through as-is when given.

notes.create.title: Create note
notes.create.description: Add a note to an Intercom contact (POST /contacts/{id}/notes). A create, so no EffectPolicy; returns the provider note JSON.

adminId.description: Admin authoring the note (maps to admin_id).

notes.list.title: List notes
notes.list.description: List the notes on an Intercom contact (GET /contacts/{id}/notes).

notes.get.title: Get note
notes.get.description: Get an Intercom note by id (GET /notes/{id}).

contacts.merge.title: Merge lead into user
contacts.merge.description: Merge an Intercom lead into a user (POST /contacts/merge). One-shot: the source lead stops resolving, so no EffectPolicy.

fromContactId.description: Lead contact id to merge away from (maps to from).

intoContactId.description: User contact id to merge into (maps to into).

conversations.attach_contact.title: Attach contact to conversation
conversations.attach_contact.description: Add a contact as a participant on an Intercom conversation (POST /conversations/{id}/customers). Reconciles against conversations.get, whose contacts list shows participants.

adminId.description: Admin adding the participant (maps to admin_id).

contactId.description: Intercom contact id to attach (maps to customer.intercom_user_id).

tickets.tag.title: Tag ticket
tickets.tag.description: Attach a tag to an Intercom ticket (POST /tickets/{id}/tags). No EffectPolicy: the 2.13 ticket object returned by tickets.get has no tags field.

tagId.description: Tag id to attach (maps to body id).

adminId.description: Admin applying the tag (maps to admin_id).

tickets.untag.title: Untag ticket
tickets.untag.description: Remove a tag from an Intercom ticket (DELETE /tickets/{id}/tags/{tagId} with admin_id body). No EffectPolicy: the 2.13 ticket object returned by tickets.get has no tags field.

adminId.description: Admin removing the tag (maps to admin_id).

teams.get.title: Get team
teams.get.description: Get an Intercom team by id (GET /teams/{id}).

contacts.list_companies.title: List companies for contact
contacts.list_companies.description: List the companies attached to an Intercom contact (GET /contacts/{id}/companies).

companies.list_contacts.title: List contacts for company
companies.list_contacts.description: List the contacts attached to an Intercom company (GET /companies/{id}/contacts).

contacts.list_tags.title: List tags for contact
contacts.list_tags.description: List the tags attached to an Intercom contact (GET /contacts/{id}/tags).

tags.get.title: Get tag
tags.get.description: Get an Intercom tag by id (GET /tags/{id}).

contacts.block.title: Block contact
contacts.block.description: Block an Intercom contact (POST /contacts/{id}/block). Intercom also archives the contact's conversations and the API has no unblock route. No EffectPolicy: the contact object returned by contacts.get has no blocked field.

contacts.get_by_external_id.title: Get contact by external id
contacts.get_by_external_id.description: Get an Intercom user contact by your external id (GET /contacts/find_by_external_id/{externalId}). Users only, not leads.

externalId.description: External id you assigned to the user (maps to the external_id path segment).

tags.delete.title: Delete tag
tags.delete.description: Delete an Intercom workspace tag (DELETE /tags/{id}). Intercom answers 200 with no body, so the result is a fixed {type, id, deleted} envelope.

companies.list_notes.title: List company notes
companies.list_notes.description: List the notes on an Intercom company (GET /companies/{id}/notes). This route first appears in Intercom-Version 2.15, so this op alone sends 2.15.

companies.scroll.title: Scroll companies
companies.scroll.description: Iterate over all Intercom companies with the Scroll API (GET /companies/scroll). Omit scrollParam to open a scroll, then pass the returned scroll_param. One open scroll per app, and it expires after 1 minute idle.

scrollParam.description: Scroll cursor returned by the previous call (maps to scroll_param).
